name: fix-campaign-battlements
about: bugs 10.22.26 line 39 (the level side): the first HoH1 Battlements floor of the normal Dark Citadel loads. The bot reads its mission index from `hwp campaign citadel` (the two Dark Halls floors come first), starts it with `gl mission dark_citadel <index>`, and checks the level file is the imported hoh1/levels/battlements_1.lvl, the player is alive and no script exception or missing resource was logged; then a screenshot. Needs the HoH1 import (the lab has it). About 3 minutes.

steps.name: hwp_battlements_1 is in the Dark Citadel and loads as the HoH1 level
the floor list the module built
